policy.classificationNote: The JLPT has not published an official vocabulary list for the current N1-N5 system. N1 membership is based on the Waller community list and is cross-checked against JMdict identity data.
policy.copyrightRule: Only sources with compatible reuse terms are used. Proprietary Japanese-Korean dictionary dumps are excluded.
policy.editorialRule: Korean glosses and project example text are project editorial content unless a row explicitly records a reusable upstream source. User-authored workbook values take precedence when the same word+reading is present.

sources.notes: Community classification, not JLPT-official. Never imported blindly; malformed, duplicate, or identity-inconsistent entries are rejected before the final 3,000-word corpus is frozen.

sources.license: jmdict-simplified distribution format CC-BY-SA 4.0; underlying JMdict data under the EDRDG/JMdict license
sources.notes: Join Waller vocabulary through jmdict_seq where possible; the production corpus stores only the fields needed by song-project.

sources.license: Repository data distributed under CC-BY-SA 4.0; grammar prose/examples are project-original curation from general grammar knowledge
sources.notes: All upstream entries are marked draft, so song-project performs its own production checks and does not represent them as native-speaker-reviewed.

About 299 unique rows after normalization. N2-labeled rows are not promoted to N1 merely because they appear in a workbook; they are used only when the same word+reading independently qualifies for the N1 production candidate set.

excludedSources.source: Naver Japanese/Korean dictionary dumps or converted Yomitan dictionaries
excludedSources.reason: Proprietary/reuse terms are not suitable as a production redistribution source for this repository.

excludedSources.reason: Contained generated-looking or duplicate vocabulary and cannot be treated as a trusted lexical source.
